event_data.context: The 5.0.5 repair rebuilt the correct Git identity fallback and passed signed out-of-sandbox fixtures, but the post-reinstall live Codex check still fails at final_review.plan because the advisory GitEventStore writes repository .git metadata that Codex workspace-write protects. The exact packaged binary succeeds outside the sandbox. Codex 0.147 external MCP configuration has approval controls but no per-server permission profile, so invocation approval cannot grant the server repository Git writes. Re-scope plugin-advisory persistence to sandbox-compatible local EventCore state; keep signed Git authority and remote publication exclusively in standalone Tiber / WorkflowCore. Preserve assess-plan reviewer orchestration, restart/resume, advance/clean, local isolation, and no remote publication. The stashed Tiber spike remains untouched until this bootstrap repair is delivered and reinstalled.
event_data.summary: Make plugin-advisory final-review persistence work inside Codex workspace-write without weakening signed Git authority for standalone Tiber.
event_data.title: Fix shared review EventCore append failures
